notable: Ohio State 56-3 over Ball State. Texas 59-7 over Texas State.
injuries: Ohio State WR Kyle Parker and RB Anthony Rogers were both unavailable in Week 1; Parker missed most of fall camp. Week 2 status unconfirmed, no school report (Eleven Warriors).
Texas reported zero injuries and all 105 players available in Week 1. LT Trevor Goosby was cleared from a knee bone bruise and played (Hook'em Headlines).

notable: Oklahoma 51-0 over UTEP. Michigan 13-12 over Western Michigan on a Hail Mary after the clock was reset to one second.
injuries: Oklahoma is down both centers: starter Jake Maikkula out 4-6 weeks with a sprained MCL and unlikely here, backup Ryan Fodje missed Week 1 with a knee, MRI pending (GBM Wolverine, CBS injury tracker).
Michigan LT Andrew Babalola out, OL Ace Hamilton out for the season. S Rod Moore and DE John Henry Daley cleared and back (GBM Wolverine).
coaching: Michigan is in year one under Kyle Whittingham, hired from Utah in December after Sherrone Moore was fired.

notable: Oregon 34-27 over Boise State. Oklahoma State lost 24-10 at Tulsa.
injuries: Oregon WRs Iverson Hooks and Jalen Lott both missed Week 1; EDGE Nasir Wyatt played with a club on his right hand. No return timeline, unconfirmed (SI).
Oklahoma State LT Jacob Sexton left early at Tulsa with a leg injury, severity not disclosed, unconfirmed (SI).
coaching: Oklahoma State is in year one under Eric Morris. Tulsa was his debut and a loss.
transfers: Oklahoma State QB Drew Mestemaker debuted 29-of-49 for 241 yards, 1 TD and 2 interceptions.

notable: Alabama 48-10 over East Carolina. Kentucky 45-13 over Youngstown State.
injuries: Alabama RB AK Dear out roughly six weeks after tightrope surgery. RB EJ Crowell was expected back for this game; WR Noah Rogers ahead of schedule on a knee (Tide 100.9).
Kentucky DBs Teryhon Nichols and Hassan Sykes did not play in Week 1, reason not stated, unconfirmed. RB T. Mizell listed out, projected to miss the season (Covers).
coaching: Kentucky is in year one under Will Stein. Youngstown State was his debut.
transfers: Alabama QB Keelon Russell made his first start. Kentucky QB Kenny Minchey went 18-of-27 for 301 yards and 4 TDs.

notable: Tennessee 56-9 over Furman. Georgia Tech lost 14-13 to Colorado.
injuries: Tennessee C Sam Pendleton was held out of Week 1 after warmups; Heupel said he expects him back for this game (Rocky Top Insider). Two linebackers including Arion Carter also missed Week 1. S Edrees Farooq is out for the season with a torn patella tendon.
Georgia Tech RB Justice Haynes had foot surgery (AJC).
transfers: Georgia Tech's QB is Alberto Mendoza, an Indiana transfer, replacing Haynes King.

notable: Iowa State 38-10 over Southeast Missouri State. Iowa 40-0 over Northern Illinois.
injuries: Iowa had five players out for the opener: S Tyler Brown, OL Trent Wilson, WR Lance Beeghley, DB Kyler Gerardy and DL Lance Ingold. Three more left the NIU game: RB LJ Phillips Jr., C Cael Winter and RG Kade Pieper, no diagnosis published, unconfirmed (Dear Old Gold, Sportfiles).
coaching: Iowa State is in year one under Jimmy Rogers, hired from Washington State after Matt Campbell left for Penn State.
transfers: Iowa State QB is Jaylen Raynor, an Arkansas State transfer. Longtime starter Rocco Becht followed Campbell to Penn State.

notable: Arkansas 31-14 over North Alabama. Utah 66-14 over Idaho.
injuries: Arkansas RB Cam Settles, DL Keiundre Johnson and DL Quincy Rhodes Jr. all carried previously undisclosed injuries; surfaced via a CBS report rather than the school, so unconfirmed (SI).
coaching: Arkansas is in year one under Ryan Silverfield. Utah is in year one under Morgan Scalley, who succeeded Kyle Whittingham.

notable: Missouri 54-14 over Arkansas-Pine Bluff. Kansas 51-6 over Long Island.
injuries: Kansas LB Bam Crouch hurt his shoulder on the second drive of Week 1; Leipold said availability for this game is uncertain and Quincy Davis would likely start (SI).
Missouri was without RB Ahmad Hardy and LT Cayden Green in Week 1. No Week 2 update found.
transfers: Missouri QB Austin Simmons, an Ole Miss transfer, debuted 17-of-19 for 280 yards and 4 TDs.

notable: Texas Tech 33-10 over Abilene Christian. Oregon State lost 33-20 at Houston.
injuries: Texas Tech EDGE Trey White out week-to-week with a knee. Also out in Week 1: LB Kaegan Ash, OL Ren Brown, EDGE LaDamion Guyton, CB Ashton Hampton, WRs Quintaelyn Joyner and Kai Powell, no Week 2 status given (Heartland College Sports).
suspensions: Texas Tech S Brenden Jordan is missing the first two games for non-injury reasons, so he misses this one too (Heartland College Sports).
coaching: Oregon State is in year one under JaMarcus Shephard.

notable: Louisiana 38-7 over Lamar. USC 39-0 over Fresno State, after a Week 0 win over San Jose State.
injuries: USC OG/C Kilian O'Connor is out for the season with a knee injury (CBS injury tracker).
transfers: USC QB Jayden Maiava went 20-of-22 for 330 yards and 3 TDs in Week 1.

notable: Penn State 45-0 over Marshall. Temple 38-14 over Rhode Island.
injuries: Penn State out in Week 1: DTs Armstrong Nnodim and Alijah Carnell, OT Owen Aliciene, DE LaVar Arrington II. The Big Ten no longer requires injury reports for non-conference games, so all of this is unconfirmed (Victory Bell Rings).
coaching: Penn State is in year one under Matt Campbell, hired from Iowa State.
transfers: Penn State QB is Rocco Becht, who followed Campbell from Iowa State. Temple rotated QBs Jaxon Smolik and Ajani Sheppard every two drives in Week 1.

notable: Texas A&M 50-0 over Missouri State.
injuries: Texas A&M RB Tiger Riden Jr. and DT Chace Sims are both out for the season; Elko did not disclose the injuries. S Tawfiq Byard and WR Madden Williams did not dress in Week 1, reported as possibly precautionary, unconfirmed (SI, Gig Em Gazette).
Arizona State LB Z. Fiaseu on IR with a knee (Covers).
transfers: Arizona State's starting QB is Cutter Boley, a Kentucky transfer.

notable: Mississippi State 62-13 over UL Monroe. Minnesota 59-7 over Eastern Illinois.
injuries: Minnesota RB A. Turner, WR B. Stevens and TE K. Helms all listed questionable. Aggregator listing only, unconfirmed (Covers).

notable: Duke 17-3 over Tulane, Sheppard rushing for 227 yards. Illinois 42-23 over UAB.
Memphis 42-24 over Arkansas State and 27-21 over UNLV in Week 0, so 2-0. Boise State lost 34-27 at Oregon.
coaching: Memphis HC Charles Huff was named Bear Bryant National Coach of the Week after the Arkansas State win.

notable: Rutgers lost 37-21 at home to UMass. Boston College lost 34-15 at Cincinnati.
Wake Forest 38-16 over Akron. Purdue 44-19 over Indiana State.
injuries: Purdue TE Kylan Fox and DB Raderrion Daniels were out in Week 1; LT Joey Tanona's ankle status was unclear and Odom declined to elaborate, unconfirmed (SI).
transfers: Wake Forest QB Gio Lopez, a North Carolina transfer, threw for 313 yards and 3 TDs in the first half of his debut.

injuries: Kansas State's line is badly hit: LT John Pastore out for the season, LT/RT George Fitzpatrick out for the season, OL Oliver Miller out several weeks, LG Tanner Morley day-to-day. CB Donovan McIntosh day-to-day (Yahoo, CBS injury tracker).
coaching: Kansas State is in year one under Collin Klein. Washington State is in year one under Kirby Moore, previously Missouri's OC.
transfers: Washington State added 50 new players including 29 four-year transfers. QB is Caden Pinnick, a UC Davis transfer.

notable: Old Dominion 31-10 over Norfolk State. Virginia Tech 73-3 over VMI.
injuries: Virginia Tech's Tyseer Denmark and Benjamin Eziuka were both hurt late against VMI but walked off; no formal report exists for non-conference games, severity unconfirmed (247Sports).
coaching: Virginia Tech is in year one under James Franklin.
transfers: Virginia Tech QB is Ethan Grunkemeyer, a Penn State transfer, named starter and captain.

notable: Georgia 63-3 over Tennessee State.
injuries: Georgia RB Dante Dowdell out indefinitely after an ATV accident. OLB Amaris Williams may miss the season with a knee. CB Justice Fitzpatrick questionable, cleared from a torn ACL but not yet tackling live (247Sports).
transfers: Georgia DT Xzavier McLeod is no longer with the program following a criminal trespass charge (247Sports).

notable: Rice 31-3 over Houston Christian with 465 rushing yards.
injuries: Notre Dame's Week 1 availability report listed eight players out: WR Quincy Porter, OL Matty Augustine, OL Charles Jagusah, OL Chris Terek, DL Christopher Burgess Jr., DL Tiki Hola, LB Ko'o Kia and CB Chaz Smith. LB Kyngstonn Viliamu-Asa questionable (On3).

notable: UConn 56-7 over Lafayette in Jason Candle's debut.
injuries: Maryland EDGE Zahir Mathis is out for the 2026 season with a knee injury (Baltimore Sun, CBS).
UConn QB Jake Merklinger did not suit up in Week 1; the broadcast reported a wrap on his throwing hand and no Thursday practice. Observation only, unconfirmed (Yahoo).
coaching: UConn is in year one under Jason Candle, after a decade at Toledo.
transfers: UConn named QB Kalieb Osborne, a Toledo transfer, less than 24 hours before kickoff. Over 80 new players joined the roster.

notable: Utah State lost 29-17 at home to Idaho State, the FCS side's first win in Logan since 2000.
injuries: Utah State QB McCae Hillstead appeared to injure his hand in Week 1 and backup Grady Brosterhous took over late. Reporter observation, unconfirmed (KSL).
Washington C Landen Hatchett is out with a fractured wrist; Kolt Dieterich steps in (Spokesman-Review).

notable: UCF 73-6 over Bethune-Cookman. Pittsburgh 59-14 over Miami (OH).
injuries: UCF EDGE Bruno Dall was ruled out for Week 1; DT RJ Jackson Jr. and WR Duane Thomas Jr. were game-time decisions (SI).
transfers: Pitt QB Mason Heintschel threw for 453 yards and 7 TDs in Week 1, tying the school record.

notable: Syracuse 66-3 over New Hampshire.
injuries: Syracuse RBs Ahmad Miller and Ju'Juan Johnson were both unavailable in Week 1, reasons not stated, unconfirmed (Yahoo).
transfers: Syracuse QB Steve Angeli went 20-of-29 for 263 yards and 3 TDs.

notable: Michigan State 30-20 over Toledo. Eastern Michigan lost 27-21 to San Jose State.
injuries: Michigan State LB Jordan Hall left with an apparent arm injury, RB Cam Edwards with a lower leg injury and RB Marvis Parrish unspecified. All in-game observations, severity unconfirmed (Yahoo).
Eastern Michigan starting OL Cole Powell exited injured (Eastern Echo).
coaching: Michigan State is in year one under Pat Fitzgerald, with new OC Nick Sheridan.

notable: Delaware 42-7 over Merrimack. Vanderbilt 28-9 over Austin Peay, shortened by lightning.
injuries: Vanderbilt TE Cole Spence was questionable before Week 1; WRs Cole Adams and Ja'Cory Thomas returned after missing camp time (SI).
transfers: Vanderbilt is in its first season after Diego Pavia. Blaze Berlowitz started with five-star freshman Jared Curtis also taking snaps.

notable: Bowling Green lost 20-13 at home to FCS Tarleton State. Nebraska 49-21 over Ohio.
injuries: Nebraska LB Owen Chambliss sat out with a hamstring; LBs Vincent Shavers and Dawson Merritt required medical attention during the game, severity unconfirmed (On3).
transfers: Nebraska QB Anthony Colandrea threw for 275 yards; freshman RB Jamal Rule ran for 122 yards and 3 TDs.

injuries: UCLA DL Amier Washington and S Tao Johnson were both injured on the opening drives of Week 1. Live-blog observations, severity unconfirmed (Yahoo).
transfers: San Diego State lost 9 of 11 defensive starters and is in its first Pac-12 season. UCLA QB Nico Iamaleava made his season debut.

coaching: LSU is in year one under Lane Kiffin.
transfers: Unresolved: the SEC rule barring players who signed with NFL teams is being litigated. Dae'Quan Wright and Zxavian Harris both claim enrollment at LSU; Kiffin left both off the Week 1 roster. Status for this game unresolved (AP).

injuries: Clemson WR T.J. Moore day-to-day with a lower body injury; S Polo Anderson out for the season with a knee. OL Adam Guthrie and RB Peyton Streko also out for the season (CBS injury tracker, Yahoo).
transfers: Clemson had not named a starting QB as of fall camp, with Christopher Vizzina in front. Clemson entered Week 1 unranked for the first time since 2011.
Georgia Southern returns just six starters and none on offense. Treat any rating built on last season's form with caution.

notable: Charlotte lost 43-41 in triple overtime at home to FCS The Citadel.
injuries: Ole Miss reported no injuries and full availability for Week 1 (SI).

notable: USF 19-9 over FIU. Army 59-3 over Bryant.
coaching: USF is in year one under Brian Hartline, with a first-year OC and DC. Army has a first-year DC in Daryl Dixon.

notable: App State 55-3 over Maine. East Carolina lost 48-10 at Alabama.
injuries: East Carolina WR Brock Spalding is expected out a few weeks with a disc injury per HC Blake Harrell. WR Landon Sides is day-to-day and expected available (247Sports).

notable: UL Monroe lost 31-3 at Mississippi State. UAB lost 42-23 at Illinois.
UTSA 45-16 over UT Rio Grande Valley. Texas State lost 59-7 at Texas.
coaching: Texas State has a first-year DC and co-DC. It is also Texas State's first Pac-12 season.

notable: North Texas lost 52-16 at Indiana. UNLV lost 27-21 to Memphis in Week 0.
coaching: North Texas is in year one under Neal Brown, hired after Eric Morris left for Oklahoma State.

notable: Buffalo 21-17 over UAlbany. FIU lost 19-9 at USF.
Jacksonville State lost 33-7 at North Dakota State, then beat Eastern Kentucky 49-7. Ohio lost 49-21 at Nebraska.
Tulsa 24-10 over Oklahoma State, spoiling Eric Morris's debut. Sam Houston lost 24-21 at Troy.
Georgia State 59-10 over North Carolina A&T. Kennesaw State 47-0 over West Georgia.
transfers: Kennesaw State QB Rickie Collins made his first start: 18-of-23, 171 yards, 1 passing TD, 51 rushing yards and 2 rushing TDs.

notable: Marshall lost 45-0 at Penn State. Middle Tennessee's opener against Murray State was weather-delayed and the final was not available at research time.
coaching: Marshall has a first-year DC in Brad Lambert.

notable: South Alabama 39-14 over SE Louisiana. Tulane lost 17-3 at Duke.
coaching: Tulane is in year one under Will Hall with an entirely new offensive and defensive staff. Hall called the opener a really poor performance.
transfers: Tulane's QB job is unsettled: Zeon Chriss-Gremillion started and went 6-of-9 for 64 yards before Kadin Semonza replaced him in the second half.

notable: Navy 42-15 over Towson.
coaching: Navy has a first-year DC in Eric Lewis.
transfers: Navy QB is senior Braxton Woodson, taking over from the graduated Blake Horvath.

notable: Southern Miss 49-3 over Alcorn State. Auburn 17-16 over Baylor in the Aflac Kickoff Game.
coaching: Southern Miss is in year one under Blake Anderson.
transfers: Southern Miss carries roughly 75 newcomers. QB is Ethan Hampton, an Illinois transfer. Treat any rating built on last season's form with caution.

notable: North Dakota State beat Jacksonville State 33-7 and Fordham 38-0. Air Force 34-0 over Duquesne.
transfers: 2026 is North Dakota State's first season in FBS and in the Mountain West. The ratings have no comparable history for them, so read any number on this game with caution.

notable: Sacramento State lost 28-17 at Eastern Michigan. Fresno State lost 39-0 at USC, its first opening-game shutout in 82 years.
coaching: Sacramento State replaced its entire coaching staff: first-year head coach Alonzo Carter, first-year OC and first-year DC.
transfers: Sacramento State is in its first FBS season, in the MAC. Fresno State is in its first Pac-12 season. Both sides changed division or conference, so the ratings are working from history that may not apply.

notable: New Mexico State lost 34-17 at Florida State. Hawai'i lost 37-27 at Stanford.
injuries: Hawai'i RB Cam Barfield was ruled out with an ankle and WR Pofele Ashlock was unavailable with an undisclosed injury in Week 1. Week 2 availability unconfirmed (FOX Sports).
